name: Saint John Accessible Transit (handi-bus)
who: People with disabilities unable to use regular transit; attendant rides free
what: Door-to-door accessible service, operated by Independence Plus Inc. Fares in city: $5.50 single, 10-ride $50, 20-ride $90, private booking $75/h. Book/cancel 506-648-0609 (60 min cancel notice); admin 506-643-7004. Fact-sheet PDF: https://saintjohn.ca/sites/default/files/documents/Saint%20John%20Accessible%20Transit%20What%20You%20Need%20to%20Know.pdf
notes: Page does not describe registration/qualification steps; phone only. Fares dated Oct 2024 PDF.

name: P.R.O. Kids financial assistance (recreation)
who: Children/youth 2-18 in low-income families (Saint John, Grand Bay-Westfield, Quispamsis, Rothesay per city notice); staff verify financial need
what: Pays all or part of registration fees for organized sports/arts/culture; page also mentions equipment and transportation. Not reimbursement of fees already paid. Apply via prokidssj.ca
notes: Detail page https://saintjohn.ca/en/parks-and-recreation/pro-kids fetched; no income threshold stated. Child-only, no adult subsidy found.

name: Transit Fare Assistance Program
who: Registered Fredericton non-profit agencies apply; individuals cannot apply directly (get tickets via an agency)
what: Single-ride and Para Transit tickets given to agencies to distribute to clients for medical, education, employment, services. 2026: 38 agencies, 11,040 tickets
notes: 2026 intake closed. Contacts tfap@fredericton.ca, info@socialinnovationfredericton.com. Indirect route for low-income residents. News: https://www.fredericton.ca/node/840523

name: Codiac Transpo accessibility and CNIB/attendant fares
who: CNIB cardholders; people with disabilities and their companions
what: CNIB cardholders ride free on all buses (valid card). Companions/attendants ride free (attendant pass from 140 Millennium Blvd). Fixed-route accessibility info; scooter pre-approval by phone (506) 857-2008
notes: No separate paratransit/Dial-a-Ride service described on page. Fares page https://www.codiactranspo.ca/moncton-transport/fares confirms CNIB free, companions free, seniors free Wednesdays, 30-day pass $73 adult/$58 student-senior, U12 free for under 12 in Moncton/Dieppe/Riverview. Fares page lists NO low-income pass.
